title: Nearly Gorenstein blow-up algebras over two-dimensional regular local rings
summary: In this paper, we slightly extend the framework of nearly Gorenstein graded rings introduced by Herzog-Hibi-Stamate, and investigate the nearly Gorenstein property of the blow-up algebras associated with an ideal, namely the Rees algebra, the extended Rees algebra, and the associated graded ring. We establish characterizations of the nearly Gorenstein property for these algebras and clarify the relations among them. In particular, for two-dimensional regular local rings, we obtain a complete classification of the integrally closed ideals for which these blow-up algebras are nearly Gorenstein.
